title: Watercolor "Sea La Vie" 113 Needlerush Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 14 amenity access bands.**- 6-Seater Low-Speed Vehicle- Located in the Lake District- 5 adult bikes- Private Heated Pool - Fire pit- Carriage house- Office space with desk- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout.Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Delightful days await at 113 Needlerush Drive, a gorgeous 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom Main House and Carriage House in WaterColor that sleeps 14. Located in the Lake District, enjoy 6 community pools, pickleball courts, white sand beaches, and winding nature trails throughout this resort community. Guests will love relaxing on the breezy porches and being by the private pool as worries melt away!A spacious wraparound porch with Adirondack chairs and a table for 2 sets the scene for a relaxed coastal getaway as guests arrive. In the Main House’s open great room, dark wood and white shiplap walls wrap guests in refined luxury. Sink into the 2 soft couches for a movie night on the large TV. Up to 4 can sit at the expansive island and chat with the chef of the group as they cook in the well-appointed kitchen, complete with a wine cooler and high-end appliances. The adjacent wooden dining table has seating for 8. Outside, a covered Summer kitchen with a built-in grill connects to the enclosed yard, where lush greenery adds privacy around the sparkling pool. Spend carefree days in the blissful sunshine—2 loungers and a collection of cushioned patio chairs provide plenty of seating. As the day winds down, indulge in an evening roasting marshmallows over the firepit under the star-filled sky. Guests can retire to the guest bedroom with a king bed on this level or head upstairs.On the second floor, discover a secondary hangout spot—ideal for kids and teens—with a cushy sleeper sofa, daybed, TV, and 2 bean bag chairs. A desk and access to the second-floor deck with a hanging bed swing and Adirondack chairs are tucked into a sunlit alcove. This floor has 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds.The Carriage House includes a kitchen, living area with a sleeper sofa, and a guest bedroom with a king bed.With a private pool, firepit, and multiple outdoor spaces, 113 Needlerush Drive is perfectly primed for a laid-back WaterColor vacation. Easily explore the area with parking for 1-2 cars and 5 complimentary adult bikes. Book this coastal escape today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Sleeping Area: Sitting Area with Twin Day Bed and Twin Sleeper SofaCARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Living Area: Kitchen and Queen Sleeper Sofa*Please note: Per HOA Policy, all golf cart rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Homes are permitted one golf cart per home. Homes with owner provided golf carts are not permitted to rent an additional golf cart.*Fireplace is not for guest use.
